name: Chris Wysopal
biography: Chris Wysopal is the CTO of Veracode, a provider of application security testing technology. Chris began his career as a vulnerability researcher at the renowned hacker think tank, L0pht. In 1998, Chris and 6 of his L0pht colleagues testified before the U.S. Senate on matters of U.S. government cybersecurity.
